plaatsen.tekst: For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people.
By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince
